chapter: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip
title: Russell 'Big Chief' Moore auditions in New York
summary: Trombonist Russell Moore, an Indian from Omaha, auditions at the Woodside Hotel and is sensational.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So anyway, we were catching as catch can and playing a date now and then, and so anyway, Russell Moore had been in the Texas area--I think he'd been in Oklahoma--Chief--had been in the Texas area, he had heard of me, but I had never heard of him. He came down to the Woodside Hotel, found out we were staying there, and said I'd like to audition for the group, and we talked around and I said right now I don't want to hire anybody because I'm working very little myself. And he worked out.

He was so sensational, I was excited and the guys too, but I still was saying where's the money coming from. So he said-- the Chief told me I want to get out of New York City, and so I said well, I don't know, I'm going to leave now, I might be around and things are kind of slow.
